name: Basecamp Personal
description: Basecamp Personal was a plan label for Basecamp's project-management and team-communication product, which organizes projects, to-dos, schedules, messages, files, documents, check-ins, and chat.
agentUseSummary: Basecamp Personal is not offered as a separate Relay connection. Current Basecamp packages share the same core product and API, so users connect the canonical Basecamp provider instead; this avoids duplicate OAuth grants, account bindings, policies, and cards for one service.

providerSetup.blocker: Basecamp Personal is not a distinct current provider or API surface. Basecamp's current packages share the core product, and the official API binds OAuth to a Basecamp account rather than to a Personal plan.
providerSetup.nextAction: Keep this alias unpublished and direct users to the canonical Basecamp card and connection. Re-evaluate only if 37signals launches a separate product with distinct authentication, API authority, lifecycle, and customer data.

evidence.supports: Basecamp's current pricing lists Free and Pro packages and states that the same core features are included with every package; it does not present Basecamp Personal as a separate current product.
The official Basecamp API documents one OAuth-authenticated account API with account-prefixed routes and the complete Basecamp resource surface, not a plan-specific Personal API.
Basecamp presents projects, assignments, schedules, messages, files, reports, chat, and personal task views as features of the same product.
